source: 730 Struggle
target: 730 Certamen

source: Lumian’s mind raced, unable to fully process the myriad details, but in the heat of battle, he couldn’t afford to waste a single moment overthinking.
target: Mens Lumiani celeriter cursabat, innumerabilia singula plene intelligere non posse, sed in ardore pugnae momentum quidem supervacue deliberandi perdere non poterat.

source: Only a Conspirer could deduce a possible scenario within two seconds of Mirror Substitution taking effect.
target: Solum Conspirator intra duos secundos, postquam Substitutio Speculi effecta est, possibilis eventus deduci poterat.

source: Based on Perle’s words, Franca and the others would have concluded that she was the Overseer directly above Jebus.
target: Ex verbis Perle, Franca et ceteri concluderent eam praepositam esse directe super Jebus.

source: She had sidestepped danger through the Under the Table transaction but now had no choice but to confront them head-on.
target: Per transactionem “Sub Mensa” periculum effugerat, sed nunc nihil aliud ei aderat nisi eos directe oppugnare.

source: They couldn’t let their focus waver, not even for a second.
target: Neque quidem per unam secundam permitterent ut eorum intentio vacillaret.

source: Lumian cursed inwardly, frustrated that the Blood Emperor’s residual aura had been sealed by Underworld Daoist’s death mark.
target: Lumian interius exsecravit, furens quod aura residua Imperatoris Sanguinis signo mortis Daoshi Inferorum clauseretur.

source: If not for that, his best bet would have been to activate the mark on his right palm with everything he had, allowing Alista Tudor to “descend” upon Trier once again.
target: Nisi id accidisset, optimum consilium illi fuit signum in palma dextro omni vi activare, ut Alista Tudor in Trier iterum descendere posset.

source: It would have drawn the attention of Angels from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, the God of Steam and Machinery Church, and other powerhouses hiding in the city, pressuring Perle to retreat.
target: Id attraheret attentionem Angelorum ex Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Ardentis, ex Ecclesia Deorum Vaporis et Machinarum, atque aliorum potentium in urbe latenter absconditorum, Perle ad recessum impellendo.

source: Without a second thought, Lumian triggered the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Sine secunda cogitatione, Lumian signum nigrum in umero dextro activavit.

source: His plan was to teleport out of there and into Saint Viève Cathedral.
target: Propositum eius erat inde teleportare et in Cathedralem Sanctae Viève ingredi.

source: Since Perle’s goal was to capture him alive, he obtained a conclusion through simple deduction.
target: Quoniam propositum Perle eum vivum capere fuit, per deductionem simplicem conclusionem adeptus est.

source: She would undoubtedly chase after him with all her might.
target: Ea indubitanter totis viribus eum persequeretur.

source: There’s no way she would stay put and risk failing the Under the Table transaction!
target: Nequaquam poterat manere et periclitari ut transactio “Sub Mensa” deficeret!

source: If that happened, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony would still have to deal with the conjured Punisher, but at least they wouldn’t be facing a demigod.
target: Si id eveniret, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony adhuc cum coniurato Punitore agere oporteret, sed saltem non demigodum oppugnabant.

source: Their odds of survival would be significantly better.
target: Sors eorum superesse multo melior foret.

source: For any Mid-Sequence Beyonder, even a single Sequence 4 demigod–bestowed or not–was enough to make their hearts sink with despair.
target: Nam cuique Mid-Sequence Beyonder, etiam unicum demigodum Sequenciae IV—datum sive non—satis erat ut corda eorum in desperatione deprimerent.

source: Moreover, the two Demonesses and Anthony all possessed Mirror Substitution, as well as items like the Seven-Stone Bracelet.
target: Praeterea, duo Demonessae et Anthony omnes possidebant Substitutionem Speculi, necnon res quales Armilla Septem Lapidum.

source: As long as they didn’t become a demigod’s target, they had a real shot at using the substitutes to escape to the Church of The Fool’s cathedral at Lavigny Docks.
target: Dummodo non fiissent meta demigodi, habebant veram facultatem substituta uti ad effugium in ecclesiam cathedralem “Stulti” ad portus Lavigny.

source: As Lumian’s form swiftly dissipated, he reached into his pocket with his left hand, his mind crystal clear, and grasped Mr. K’s finger.
target: Dum forma Lumiani celeriter evanuit, manu sinistra in tasca sua extendit, mens eius nitida, atque digitum Domini K apprehendit.

source: He couldn’t be sure if Perle was telling the truth about capturing him alive or if it was a lie.
target: Non poterat certi esse utrum Perle veritatem diceret de eum vivum capiendo aut mendacium esset.

source: Was it just a demigod’s nonchalance when dealing with a Mid-Sequence Beyonder, or a habit formed from a Broker’s constant deception?
target: Num id esset tantum levitas demigodi in rebus Mid-Sequence Beyonder tractandis, aut morum consuetudo ex perpetua fallacia Negotiatoris?

source: He had to be prepared for the possibility that Perle might not follow him and instead stay behind to take on Franca and the others.
target: Oportebat eum paratum esse ad occasionem, quod Perle eum sequi non curaret, sed potius manere ut Francam et ceteros oppugnaret.

source: His contingency plan was: Summon Mr. K!
target: Consilium secundarium eius fuit: Invoca Dominum K!

source: While Mr. K, as a Shepherd, couldn’t directly fight a demigod, he was the Aurora Order’s Oracle.
target: Dum Dominus K, ut Pastor, demigodum directe pugnare non poterat, fuit Oraculum Ordinis Aurorae.

source: He could hear the True Creator’s guidance at any time.
target: Potest audire ductum Veritatis Conditoris quovis tempore.

source: His presence meant that the deity he believed in would surely cast His gaze upon them.
target: Eius praesentia significabat deum in quem credebat, certo oculos suos super eos iacturum.

source: There was a good chance it would trigger some miraculous turn of events in their favor.
target: Erant magnae spei ut hoc rem miraculosum eventum in eorum favorem moveret.

source: And even without divine intervention, the Beyonder of the Apprentice pathway under Mr. K’s Grazing appeared to have records of demigod abilities.
target: Et etiam sine interventu divino, Beyonder itineris Apprenti sub cura Domini K videbatur documenta facultatum demigodarum habere.

source: It should be able to hold off Perle for a few seconds, giving Franca and the others a window to escape.
target: Id posse Perle paucos secundos conterere debebit, ita ut Francae et ceteris occasio ad effugium praebeatur.

source: As Lumian activated his teleportation, Franca, who had been compelled to use Mirror Substitution, materialized in a corner of the quarry cave.
target: Dum Lumian teleportationem suam activabat, Franca, quae ad Substitutionem Speculi cogenda erat, in angulo speluncae fodinae apparuit.

source: Clutching a makeup mirror, she decisively activated the Mirror Cufflink.
target: Tenens speculum ornamentale, firmiter Fibulam Speculi activavit.

source: She already knew Perle was the Overseer and intended to escape via the mirror world.
target: Iam sciebat Perle praeposita esse et per mundum speculi effugere velle.

source: Once concealed within the mirror world, she could jump to the mirrors on Jenna, Lumian, and Anthony.
target: Cum intra mundum speculi abscondita esset, poterat ad specula in Jenna, Lumiano, et Anthony salire.

source: She could extend her hand and pull her companions into the mirror world, and they could all flee together!
target: Manum extendere poterat et comites suos in mundum speculi trahere, atque omnes simul effugi posse!

source: The glass-like Mirror Cufflink emitted a dark light, but Franca didn’t budge, unable to enter the makeup mirror in her grasp.
target: Fibula Speculi, quasi vitrea, lucem obscuram emittens, sed Franca non movebatur, intrare enim speculum ornamentale quod tenebat non poterat.

source: Wh– Franca was stunned for a moment before a realization hit her.
target: Heu—Franca per momento stupefacta est, antequam realitas eam percuteret.

source: Failing to enter the mirror world without any interference could only mean one thing:
target: Deficio intrandi mundum speculi sine alio impedimento unum solum significare poterat:

source: This was a mirror world!
target: Hic erat mundus speculi!

source: Except for certain unique mirror worlds, one couldn’t enter the mirror world from within the mirror world itself.
target: Nisi pro quibusdam unice constitutis mundis speculi, non liceret ex interiore ipsius mundi speculi in eum intrare.

source: The only option was to use the mirror to jump!
target: Unica optio erat speculum ad transilendum adhibere!

source: Mirror worlds came in two varieties.
target: Mundi speculi duas varietates habebant.

source: The first was conventional and universal, not a true world.
target: Prima erat consueta et universalis, non verus orbis.

source: It was a concept of “doors” amalgamated into a dark void passageway linking all mirrors.
target: Erat notio “ianuarum” compositarum in obscurum vacuum transeundum, quae omnes specula coniungebat.

source: Wherever mirrors and their surfaces existed, such mirror worlds with no discernible boundaries could be found.
target: Quocumque specula et superficies eorum fuerunt, tales mundi speculi sine finibus perceptibilibus inveniri poterant.

source: The second type was special mirror worlds.
target: Secunda generis erant mundi speculi speciales.

source: They relied on the conventional mirror world and leveraged specific corruption or corresponding abilities to take shape.
target: Existimabant in mundo speculi consueto uti atque corruptione specifica aut facultatibus aequivalentiis ad formam capiendam recurrere.

source: Some were permanent, others temporary.
target: Nonnulli permanentes erant, alii temporarii.

source: Their characteristics closely mirrored the real world, projections of one facet of reality, but each had its own unique limitations and rules.
target: Eorum indoles arcte verum mundum imitabatur, ut specula unius aspectus realitatis, sed unusquisque limitationes et regulas singulares habebat.

source: The mirror world in Fourth Epoch Trier belonged to the latter category.
target: Mundus speculi in Trier, Aetatis Quartae, illius generis adstabat.

source: It contained only a projection of Trier, a sprawling metropolis, and excluded other regions.
target: Continebat solum effigiem Triers, metropolitanum spatiosum, et alias regiones excludebat.

source: Moreover, it was split into three distinct levels.
target: Praeterea in tres gradus distinctos divisus erat.

source: This mirror world was also special, but on a smaller scale.
target: Hic mundus speculi etiam specialis erat, sed magnitudine inferior.

source: It was merely a projection of the quarry cave, likely generated by some ability.
target: Hoc erat solum effigies speluncae fodinae, probabiliter aliqua facultate generata.

source: As a veteran Shadow Merchant, Perle had a long-established partnership with the Mirror People.
target: Ut veterana Mercatrix Umbrae, Perle diuturnam societatem cum Populo Speculorum habebat.

source: It was perfectly normal for her to trade items capable of creating temporary special mirror worlds!
target: Plane erat ut illa negotium faceret cum rebus quae temporarios mundos speculi speciales creare valeant!

source: Recalling the dark light emanating from Moran Avigny’s mirror just before Perle’s arrival, Franca’s suspicion was confirmed.
target: Recordans lucem obscuram quae ex speculo Moran Avigny emansit paulo ante adventum Perle, suspicio Francae confirmata est.

source: Just as she was about to warn Lumian and the others, she saw the Demoness of Black’s Punishment projection seize the moment to reflect herself in a mirror.
target: Ita ut Lumian et ceteros monere velle parata esset, vidit projectionem Demonessae Nigrae Poenae momentum capere, ut se in speculo reflecteret.

source: Franca’s pupils dilated as she activated Mirror Substitution.
target: Pupillae Francae dilatatae sunt, dum Substitutionem Speculi activavit.

source: In an instant, she transformed into a mirror, engulfed by pitch-black flames from within.
target: In momento, ipsa in speculum se convertit, ab interioribus nigris flammis absorpta.

source: Smack!
target: Strepitus!

source: The mirror slammed into the ground, shattering into countless fragments.
target: Speculum in terram collidit, innumeris fragmentis confractum.

source: At the same time, Lumian’s figure rematerialized in place.
target: Simul figura Lumiani in loco iterum apparuit.

source: His teleportation had failed.
target: Teleportatio eius defecerat.

source: This was indeed a special mirror world.
target: Hoc re vera erat mundus speculi specialis.

source: Finding an exit was the only way out.
target: Exitum inveniendi sola via egressus erat.

source: Mr. K’s finger had already expanded, morphing into a mass of flesh and blood that enveloped Lumian’s body, forming a vibrant red cloak that covered him from head to toe.
target: Digitus Domini K iam expansus erat, in massam carnis et sanguinis mutatus, quae corpus Lumiani totum involvit, pallium rubrum viventem a capite ad pedes formans.

source: With a sickening sound, Lumian’s body was pierced by grotesque wounds, as if struck by invisible arrows.
target: Cum sonitu fastidioso, corpus Lumiani ab vulneribus monstruosis perforatum est, velut sagittis invisibilibus feriendum.

source: It was only thanks to the protection of the flesh-and-blood cloak, transformed from Mr. K’s finger, that he managed to survive.
target: Solummodo propter tutelam pallii carnis et sanguinis, ex digito Domini K constitutum, superare potuit.

source: Otherwise, he would have been forced to animate his shadow to absorb those fatal injuries on his behalf.
target: Aliter, coactus fuisset umbram suam animare, ut illa fata vulnera pro se absorberet.

source: Of course, he still had one more Mirror Substitution up his sleeve—courtesy of Jenna.
target: Certe, adhuc unum Substitutionis Speculi in manibus habebat, gratia Jennae.

source: Overseer Perle stood firm beside the jutting rock deep within the quarry cave.
target: Praeposita Perle firmiter stabat iuxta saxum eminens in profundo speluncae fodinae.

source: She flashed Lumian a smile and said, “Those who defy supervision and try to flee shall face punishment.”
target: Illa Lumian subridens aspexit et dixit: “Qui supervisionem contemnunt et effugere conantur, poenam pati debent.”

source: As Franca and Lumian’s attempts failed in quick succession, Jenna tossed out a handful of fluorescent dust, whispered an incantation, and promptly vanished from the Punisher dressed as a clergyman of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
target: Dum conatus Francae et Lumiani celeriter deficerent, Jenna manum pulveris lucentis iactavit, incantationem murmuravit, atque celeriter evanuit a Punitore, qui ut clericus Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Flammantis vestitus erat.

source: A golden light surged around the Punisher, clad in a white robe adorned with golden threads, spreading outward in layers.
target: Lumen aureum circum Punitorum proliferavit, qui veste alba cum filis aureis ornatus erat, et stratis extendens diffundebatur.

source: As the golden light reached an empty space, it abruptly encountered an obstacle, staining it a faint golden hue.
target: Dum lumen aureum spatium vacuum pervenit, subito in obstaculum incidit, eum leviter aureum tingens.

source: Jenna felt a surge of warmth and courage, but her eyes reflected a pure and magnificent blazing pillar of light.
target: Jenna ardorem et virtutem resensivit, sed oculi eius pilam lucis puram ac magnificentem ardentem repraesentabant.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitus!

source: The pillar of light struck her, transforming her into a mirror and shattering her into pieces.
target: Columna lucis eam percussit, transformans eam in speculum et confrangens in partes.

source: Anthony seized the chance to activate Psychological Invisibility once more.
target: Anthony occasionem arripuit ad invisibilitatem psychologicam iterum activandam.

source: However, the Trier police incarnation didn’t overlook him, as if it could detect the scent of sin on him.
target: Tamen incarnatio vigilum Triers eum non neglexit, quasi odores peccati in eo detegere posset.

source: Two bolts of lightning shot forth from the Punisher’s eyes, piercing Anthony’s soul.
target: Duo fulgura e oculis Punitoris effulserunt, animam Anthoni penetrantia.

source: Anthony’s eyes bulged, his mouth agape, but he couldn’t even muster a scream.
target: Oculi Anthoni eminuerunt, os eius apertum, sed clamorem edere quidem non potuit.

source: He stood paralyzed, rooted to the spot.
target: Stabat immobilis, in loco haerens.

source: “Death!” Trier’s police incarnation uttered a single ancient Hermes word.
target: “Mors!” incedebat incarnatio vigilum Triers, unum vetus verbum Hermes proferens.

source: Clenching his right hand into a fist, he lunged at Anthony, leaving an afterimage in his wake.
target: Dextram manum in pugnum constringens, impetum ad Anthoni fecit, post se vestigia relinquens.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Imbued with a peculiar force, the fist collided with Anthony’s head in an inescapable blow.
target: Virtute singulari imbuus, pugnum caput Anthoni in ictu inexorabili percussit.

source: Crack! Anthony shattered into countless glimmering mirror fragments.
target: Crepitus! Anthony in innumeros micantes fragmenta speculi confractus est.

source: Franca, dressed in an assassin suit, reappeared.
target: Franca, in habitu sicarii induta, iterum apparuit.

source: Confronted by a demigod’s overwhelming power, the ethereal, non‑godhood‑possessing Demoness of Black, and the sealed special mirror world, she decisively retrieved an item from her Traveler’s Bag.
target: Confrontata potentia demigodi ingenti, etherea Demonessa Nigrae, deitatis carentis, et mundo speculi speciali clauso, illa certissime obiectum ex sacculo Viatoris sui extraxit.

source: It was a silver‑white full‑body armor, taller than Franca herself.
target: Erat armatura totius corporis albo‑argentea, altior quam ipsa Franca.

source: Pride Armor!
target: Armatura Superbiæ!

source: Franca positioned the Pride Armor in front of her, its back facing Overseer Perle.
target: Franca Armaturam Superbiæ ante se posuit, dorsu versus Praepositae Perle.

source: She was convinced that the demigod was the crux of the problem, not the Punisher taking the form of the Demoness of Black.
target: Illa certissima erat demigodum esse radicem quaestionis, non Punitoris in forma Demonessae Nigrae.

source: If Perle remained unscathed, another Punisher would emerge to eliminate even after dispatching the first.
target: Si Perle impune maneret, alius Punitor emergeret ad interemendos etiam post primum exterminandos.

source: She might even face a direct “accusation.”
target: Forsitan etiam directe “accusationem” subiret.

source: Franca noticed Perle standing beside a protruding rock with a fixed entrance to the mirror world.
target: Franca animadvertit Perle iuxta saxum emergentem, cuius aditus ad mundum speculi fixus erat.

source: It led her to believe that Perle could harness the Fourth Epoch Trier’s abundant corruption to request a fixed entrance to the mirror world created by the Primordial Demoness.
target: Hoc illam adduxit ad credendum Perle abundantem corruptionem Triers Aetatis Quartae adhibere posse ad ianuam fixam ad mundum speculi, ab Demonessa Primordiali creatum, petendum.

source: Not only would it allow them to enter and exit the conventional mirror world without relying on their inherent characteristics and abilities, but it would also serve as the gateway to this special mirror world.
target: Non solum eis permittet in mundum speculi consuetum ingressum et exitum sine innatis qualitatibus et facultatibus, sed etiam ut ostium huic speculi speciali fungatur.

source: After all, it could be considered a gift from a true god!
target: Postremo, id donum a vero deo esse putari poterat!

source: The instant the Pride Armor’s feet touched the ground, it suddenly spun around, fixing an invisible gaze upon Overseer Perle.
target: Statim ut pedes Armaturae Superbiæ terram tetigerunt, illa subito se convertit, et oculum invisibilem versus Praepositae Perle infixit.

source: Franca swiftly leaped to the side and rolled, avoiding facing the Pride Armor’s back.
target: Franca celeriter ad latus progressa et voluta est, ne dorsum Armaturae Superbiæ contemplaret.

source: Thud thud thud!
target: Tum, tum, tum!

source: The silver‑white full‑body armor charged towards Overseer Perle, condensing a broadsword of light in its hand.
target: Armatura totius corporis albo‑argentea versus Praepositae Perle impetum fecit, gladium lucis latum in manu condensum.

source: In the dark cathedral bereft of a deity’s Sacred Emblem, a pea rapidly grew, transforming into a multitude of thick turquoise vines that converted the area into a lush paradise of plants and an otherworldly forest.
target: In obscura cathedralis, deitatis sacri emblēma carente, pisum celeriter crevit, transformans in multitudinem densarum vitis caeruleo‑viridum, quae regionem in luxuriantem paradisum plantarum atque silvam aliam extraneam converterent.

source: They separated the suspended corpses, preventing them from approaching The Hermit.
target: Separaverunt corpora suspendita, impediendo ut ad Eremitam accederent.

source: Judgment, who had remained silent, extended her right palm, her eyes glowing with a copper‑gold luster.
target: Iudicium, quod silens mansit, palmam dextram extendit, oculis eius fulgentibus cum nitore cupreo‑auro.

source: She spoke gravely in ancient Hermes, “Marionettes are prohibited here!”
target: Loquuta est graviter in antiquo sermone Hermes: “Marionettæ hic vetantur!”

source: The animated corpses abruptly ceased their movements, and Magician tore open the void before her, tainting it with resplendent starlight, forming an enchanting door.
target: Corpora animata subito motus cessaverunt, et Magus vacuum ante se distraxit, eum stella luce splendidissima pollens, formans ianuam incantatam.

source: Beyond the door was the portrait of a woman—Loki, who had undergone a bizarre transformation.
target: Ultra ianuam erat imago mulieris—Loki, quae transformationem miram passa est.

source: Loki reached into the air and pulled out a figure.
target: Loki in aether extendit manum et figuram extraxit.

source: The figure was a woman with a voluptuous build, dressed in a black gown.
target: Figura erat mulier voluptuosa, nigro vestita.

source: A golden crown encrusted with jewels adorned her head.
target: Corona aurea gemmis insculpta caput eius decorabat.

source: She had curly chestnut hair, blue eyes, a high nose bridge, and slightly thin lips.
target: Habebat capillos castaneos crispatos, oculos caeruleos, altum nasum et labia leviter tenue.

source: She exuded a Demoness‑like allure from the inside out.
target: Externo et interno, allicitio qualis Demonessa emanabat.
